title: Aggregation
description:
A department **has** teachers, but it does not own them: teachers exist before the department is created and carry on after it closes. In code, the department holds **pointers** to teachers that live somewhere else, and never deletes them.

Using the `Teacher` struct provided, write a class `Department` with:

- `void add(Teacher& teacher)`: remembers the teacher (store `&teacher`); adding the same teacher twice has no effect,
- `std::size_t size() const`,
- `bool has(const Teacher& teacher) const`,
- `std::string names() const`: the names joined with `", "` in the order added.
hints: Store `std::vector<Teacher*>`. `add` pushes `&teacher` unless `has(teacher)` is already true.
`has` compares addresses (`p == &teacher`). The department never deletes these pointers: the teachers belong to someone else.
